about_the_game:
"Idle Immortal: Fish-Peeking Chronicles" is a desktop idle cultivation pet game. Your desktop is more than just a desktop - it is your own personal sanctuary.

In the game, you will raise a little cultivator who permanently stays on your desktop, accompanying you while you work, study, daydream, or slack off. Whether you are seriously typing or temporarily away from your computer, your little companion will keep cultivating, accumulating power, breaking through realms, exploring opportunities, and sometimes obtaining randomly dropped gear and magical treasures.

The game focuses on a relaxed, low-interruption companion experience, combining "idle growth" with "typing interaction," so that everyday office work, study, and computer use can become a lighthearted and enjoyable cultivation journey.

You can also connect with friends online, build a sect together, share your pace of growth, idle together in your desktop world, and gradually ascend.

Game Features

- Desktop companion cultivator pet: A little cultivator accompanies you in real time and blends naturally into your daily computer use

- Typing cultivation system: Every keystroke can be converted into cultivation, making typing part of your training

- Easy idle progression: Continue growing both online and offline with relaxed development and no grinding pressure

- Realm breakthroughs and random drops: Keep improving your cultivation, break through to higher realms, and collect equipment and magical treasures

- Online sect gameplay: Idle and relax with friends, build your sect together, and grow toward ascension
